rules.sentence: When evaluating a patient with suspected acute appendicitis, the medical history, physical examination, laboratory findings, and pertinent diagnostic imaging should be holistically reviewed.
The Alvarado scoring system is a practical tool used to diagnose acute appendicitis and can help reduce the incidence of unnecessary surgery.
Still, it is not considered a highly-sensitive measure and should not be used in isolation.[10]
An Alvarado score of 7 or greater has a positive predictive value for acute appendicitis, ranging from 78% to 96%.[11]
